output.summary: RBI approved the reappointment of V. Srinivasa Rangan as Executive Director for one year starting November 23, 2026.
DoT levied penalties totaling Rs. 2.62 lakh on Bharti Airtel for subscriber verification lapses.
Bajaj Finance opened its QIP with a floor price set at ₹992.25 per share.
Approved the issuance of 5.74 crore warrants to Bajaj Finserv at ₹1,010 each, totaling ₹5,799.99 crore.
H1 FY27 PAT rose 28% to ₹12,447 crore and AUM grew by 26%.
HAL is acquiring CAE Canada's 50% stake in HATSOFF to make it a wholly owned subsidiary.
Approved Q2 FY27 results, noted exit of Dr. Madhu Sasidhar, and completion of Cloudnine divestment.
Announced Q2 results alongside a GSTAT order triggering an exceptional provision of ₹11,629.85 lakh.
